development_approach.strategy: Restructure index.html first (stable container positions), then update state.js JS wiring, then mobile.js pane registry, then CSS polish. Budget.js and drag.js require no changes.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex identified 10 implementation blockers: (1) day-select removal will crash state.js, (2) mobile.js pane IDs stale after restructure, (3) sticky day selector pattern correct but Dashboard must stay reachable on mobile, (4) budget.js hardcodes IDs — must stay mounted once, (5) approve-day-btn crash if unmounted during tab switch, (6) drag/tap binding requires stable containers — no DOM replacement, (7) title fix missing meta.title in fallback chain, (8) renderDaysPanel must reuse _deriveCityName for M3 preservation, (9) collapsible groups must preserve data-slot-id/data-origin-slot-id attributes, (10) overflow-x hidden is out of scope without measured evidence.

findings.issue: Removing #day-select without updating state.js:116 and state.js:684-695 will crash _wireDayPicker and _renderDayPickerOptions
findings.proposed_fix: Replace _wireDayPicker() / _renderDayPickerOptions() entirely with renderDaysPanel() + delegated click. Remove #day-select from HTML and all state.js references.
findings.rationale: Incorporated as M5 with explicit implementation notes

findings.issue: mobile.js _activateTab and _applyMobileLayout iterate ['candidates','timeline','budget'] which will be wrong after restructure
Dashboard must remain reachable on mobile — sticky day selector + 2 mobile tabs (Timeline/Candidates maps to middle/candidates) is correct pattern
findings.proposed_fix: Mobile tabs: ['middle','candidates']; middle pane contains both Dashboard and Timeline tabs; mobile user navigates within middle pane

findings.issue: budget.js hardcodes budget-trip-total, budget-day-total, budget-breakdown IDs; lazy-render would break
findings.proposed_fix: Budget DOM statically in Dashboard tab-content HTML; same IDs preserved; renderBudget called from renderAll which fires after init
findings.rationale: Incorporated into M2 and HTML structure spec

findings.issue: state.js:512-523 renderApproveButton accesses btn.disabled with no null guard — crashes if #approve-day-btn unmounted
findings.proposed_fix: Keep #approve-day-btn always mounted inside tab-timeline; add if (!btn) return; guard
findings.rationale: Incorporated into M3, Edge Case 2, and AC10

findings.issue: drag.js and mobile.js bind once to #candidates-groups and #timeline-slots; destroying these DOM nodes breaks all drag/tap
findings.proposed_fix: Keep both containers stable mounted; only parent tab-content divs use hidden toggle
findings.rationale: Incorporated into stable container contract (M3, M4, Edge Case 1)

findings.issue: renderDaysPanel must reuse _deriveCityName to not regress M3
findings.proposed_fix: Call _deriveCityName(day) inside renderDaysPanel for each day row

findings.issue: Collapsible groups must preserve data-slot-id and data-origin-slot-id on cards
findings.proposed_fix: Collapsible UI must not strip dataset attributes from .card-candidate elements
findings.disposition: applied — but note: collapsible groups are NOT in this spec (user requirement says grouping, not collapsing). Finding is logged.
findings.rationale: Out of scope for this cycle — user did not request collapsing. Finding logged for future reference.

findings.issue: overflow-x: hidden is out of scope without measured overflow evidence — masks bugs
findings.proposed_fix: Do not add defensive overflow-x: hidden
findings.rationale: AF-10 deferred; explicitly excluded from Won't Have

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: All 8 blocker/major findings with PROPOSED_FIX applied. 1 major finding (collapsible groups data attributes) logged but marked out-of-scope as collapsing was not requested. 1 major finding (overflow-x) applied as explicit exclusion.
